info.description: Ask Pi, the terminal coding agent, to do coding tasks. Submit a task, get a job id back immediately, then poll for the result. Jobs run one at a time in a fresh sandbox with a hard timeout.
info.title: Pi Muse Connector API

post.description: Submit a natural-language coding task to Pi (write a script, fix a bug, explain code, scaffold a project...). Returns 202 with a job_id immediately — the task runs asynchronously. Poll GET /api/pi-task/{job_id} until status is done, failed, or timeout. Rate limited per IP.

task.description: The coding task in plain words. Be specific: language, what it should do, any constraints.
task.example: Write a Python script that reads a CSV of sales data and prints total revenue per month.

post.summary: Ask Pi to do a coding task

get.description: Check a submitted task. status is queued, running, done, failed, or timeout. When done, result holds Pi's answer (usually code and/or an explanation).

error.description: Set when status is failed or timeout.

result.description: Pi's answer when status is done.

get.summary: Poll a Pi task for its result
